$comment: Evidence rules dari The Challenger Sale (mapping §4). PERHATIAN: CS-R06 konflik dengan TM rules di fase discovery — aktif hanya saat applicability condition AC-01 terpenuhi (fase OFFER/COMPLEX-SALE).

evidence_rules.condition: user answers the reframe question with total agreement ('exactly my problem') without surprise
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS that customers respond to their pitch with total agreement ('exactly our problem') WITHOUT surprise or new insight, yet deals still die.

consequence.rationale: Persetujuan = mengajar di margin; tidak ada reframe — value framing belum terbedakan dari kompetitor.

evidence_rules.condition: user menghadapi permintaan diskon dan responsnya menurunkan harga tanpa percakapan value
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS that when asked for a discount, they respond by directly lowering the price without any value conversation or trade.

consequence.rationale: Passive posture — caving; time-for-money/margin trap terkunci; transaksional decay.

evidence_rules.condition: deal via RFP/junior contact TANPA akses ke decision maker atau key executives
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS pursuing deals that arrive via RFP/tender or through junior staff (e.g. purchasing), WITHOUT access to the real decision maker; deals stall 'waiting for the boss'.

consequence.rationale: ≈20% of opportunities are verification foils — qualification is invalid; time is better spent elsewhere.

evidence_rules.condition: identical sales message for all stakeholders in a multi-person deal
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS using one identical sales message/deck for ALL stakeholders, with no per-role tailoring.

consequence.rationale: Consensus buying butuh resonansi per-role; satu pesan = 'so what?' dari non-teknikal stakeholder.

evidence_rules.condition: The teaching/insight shared does NOT lead to a unique strength that only the user has.
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS teaching insights to customers, but those insights do NOT connect to any unique strength they alone can deliver.

consequence.rationale: Free consulting — good insight but doesn’t result in a win; don’t count it as value framing.

evidence_rules.condition: APPLICABILITY: penjualan kompleks/disruptive DAN strategi user relationship-first (delay semua komersial, defuse tension)
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS selling complex/disruptive services while describing a relationship-first passive approach (build relationship first, sell later).

consequence.rationale: Profil pendekatan salah untuk konteks complex sale — Relationship Builder ≈0% star. AKTIF hanya di fase OFFER; nonaktif saat fase LEARNING (AC-01).
